notes.paraphrase: For natal Mewa numbered 1–9, the corresponding vitality Mewa is the natal index plus six modulo nine (with 9 representing zero), and power Mewa is plus three modulo nine; for natal 5 these are 2 and 8; body Mewa equals natal-year Mewa.
notes.provenance_note: Compare independently with Cornu's natal Mewa tables and the White Beryl primary translation before claiming genuine traditional equivalence.

notes.paraphrase: For current-year versus natal elemental power Mewa, maternal element is given best classification (three zero marks), friend two, son one zero/one cross, enemy two crosses; identity Earth/Water one zero, Fire/Iron/Wood one cross.
notes.provenance_note: Same pebble ordering appears in Dorje's translation commentary, so repeated books do not count as independent evidence.

notes.paraphrase: For men Papme Mewa begins with natal Mewa as first Tibetan age year and follows magic-square arrows counterclockwise through current Tibetan age.
notes.provenance_note: Age convention and traversal directions must be explicit, not silently substituted by Western attained age.

notes.paraphrase: For women Papme Mewa traverses the same style of magic square clockwise starting from the natal Mewa in the center.
notes.provenance_note: Gendered variants separately preregistered; avoid using identity as a fitted correction.

notes.paraphrase: The Gua Annual Number in Erlewine uses an exact astronomical transition around February 4, with UTC/GMT threshold and distinct male and female personal-Gua lookup numbers; this need not match variable Tibetan lunisolar New Year.
notes.provenance_note: Author's presentation blends Tibetan astrology with Chinese feng-shui solar-sector number conventions; do not mistake Feb 4 cutoff for canonical Phugpa Losar.

notes.paraphrase: Personal Gua natal month uses the Sun in tropical zodiac sectors from degree 15 of one sign to degree 15 of the next; this is not by default the Tibetan Kālacakra month or the Tibetan lunar birth month.
notes.provenance_note: Modern author/Chinese-derived variant; keep distinct from the original White Beryl lunar/zodiac/planet conventions.
